st.hero.title: Spent Today
st.hero.subtitle: Mindful daily expense tracking, Needs vs. Wants clarity, and multi-currency travel envelopes.
st.features.title: Spend Less. Save More. Zero Bank Logins.
st.features.subtitle: Designed around calm daily awareness rather than overwhelming spreadsheets.
st.feature1.title: Needs vs. Wants
st.feature1.description: Classify purchases as essential or discretionary in one tap and calculate realistic daily limits from your income.

st.showcase.body: Keep vacation or business trip budgets separate from everyday expenses. Record local-currency purchases on the go, track prepaid bookings, and stay comfortably within your daily travel allowance.
st.faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
st.faq1.title: Is my financial data private?
st.faq1.description: Yes. No bank account connections are required. All entries remain on your device and sync privately via your personal iCloud account.
st.faq2.title: What is included for free?
st.faq2.description: Daily expense tracking, Needs vs. Wants classification, and core daily budget limits are free to use, with optional Premium plans unlocking extended analytics and unlimited travel envelopes.
st.faq3.title: Can I export my transaction history?
st.faq3.description: Yes, you can search, filter by date, and export your full history or individual trip recaps to CSV anytime.
inv.hero.title: My Inventory Stack
inv.hero.subtitle: Smart Inventory, Barcode Scanning & Business Operations
inv.features.title: All-in-One Inventory Control
inv.features.subtitle: Engineered for independent retailers, studios, pop-up shops, and serious collectors.
inv.feature1.title: Command Dashboard
inv.feature1.body: Monitor total inventory value, low-stock alerts, out-of-stock counts, and quick barcode scan actions in real time.

inv.faq2.body: Yes. All records are stored privately in your personal iCloud account for seamless synchronization across your iPhone and iPad.

inv.faq3.body: Yes. Logging a sale automatically deducts item quantities, triggers low-stock alerts when needed, and updates your profit analytics.
as.hero.title: ArchiveShelf
as.hero.subtitle: Private home and studio asset inventory with room hierarchies, warranty alerts, and PDF reports.
as.features.title: Everything You Own, Structured with Precision
as.features.subtitle: Catalog household belongings, tech workstations, collectibles, and moving boxes with complete peace of mind.

cp.features.subtitle: From outdoor golden-hour tracking to studio lighting layouts and client paperwork—all in your pocket.

cp.feature1.body: Inspect solar elevation, azimuth compass bearings, shadow ratios, sunrise, and golden hour for any date and location worldwide—even offline.
cp.feature2.title: Shoot & Studio Planner
cp.feature2.body: Organize shoot schedules, locations, and notes alongside an interactive drag-and-drop studio lighting diagram planner.

cp.feature3.body: Choose from ready-to-use model, property, TFP, client, and event release templates, collect signatures on screen, and export clean PDFs in seconds.

cp.showcase1.body: Position strobes, softboxes, reflectors, backdrops, and camera angles before shoot day so setup on location is effortless and repeatable.
cp.showcase1.subbody: Link call times, map coordinates, shot checklists, and lighting diagrams directly inside each project.
cp.showcase2.title: Sign on Screen & Share Clean PDFs

cp.faq1.title: Is CamPouch built for professionals or enthusiasts?

cp.faq2.title: Is my client and project data private?
cp.faq2.body: Yes. All project schedules, client details, signed PDFs, and locations are stored locally on your device and synced privately via your personal iCloud account.
cp.faq3.title: Does the sun tracker work offline?
cp.faq3.body: Yes. Core solar path, elevation, and golden-hour calculations run completely offline so you can plan reliably in remote outdoor locations.

Master Japanese
every time you check your phone.

vb.faq2.title: What is included for free?
vb.faq2.body: Vocab Bento includes the complete JLPT N5 curriculum, Kana charts, and hourly Lock Screen widgets for free, with Vocab Bento Pro unlocking JLPT N4–N1 and specialized situational lesson packs.
vb.faq3.title: Does it include audio pronunciations?
vb.faq3.body: Yes, all vocabulary entries and Kana charts feature high-quality native audio recordings so you can master accurate pitch and pronunciation.
vb.faq4.title: Can I study offline?
vb.faq4.body: 100% offline. All 6,000+ words, audio clips, and spaced repetition schedules are stored directly on your iPhone with optional private iCloud sync.
privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro.title: Your Privacy is Fundamental to Our Architecture.
privacy.intro.description: At Pandesal Bytes, we believe your personal and business data belongs exclusively to you. Every application we publish is engineered to be private by design, delivering dependable productivity tools without compromising customer confidentiality.
privacy.collection.title: Data Collection and Storage
privacy.collection.description:
We do not collect, transmit, store, or sell personal information or behavioral usage data from our applications.

All records created in our applications are stored locally on your device and, where enabled, synchronized privately through Apple's iCloud service under your own Apple Account. Pandesal Bytes has no access to this data.
privacy.thirdparty.title: Third-Party Services & Analytics
privacy.thirdparty.description: Our applications contain no third-party advertising networks, cross-app tracking libraries, or external behavioral analytics SDKs.
privacy.changes.title: Policy Updates
privacy.changes.description: As our product lineup evolves, we may update this Privacy Policy to reflect new capabilities while maintaining strict transparency. Any updates will be published directly on this page.
